messages:
Maria Chen: quick design check — pushing a small iteration to button variants and spacing tokens, want eyes on a11y and density tradeoffs. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz/button-variants
Alex Rivera: thanks — quick q: are we adding a new 'tertiary' or leaning on secondary with different border?
Maria Chen: tertiary as ghost with subtle hover. main changes: 1) icon-only btns get explicit aria-label guidance, 2) compact density token (-2) for table rows and small buttons, 3) focus ring is 3px instead of 2 to meet contrast on dark backgrounds.
Dave K: I saw the focus ring change — does 3px break visual rhythm? can we test with inline form fields?
Maria Chen: good call, testing in forms next. also: updated outline color to #004E8A for WCAG 3:1 on accent backgrounds.
Samir Patel: accessibility nit — for icon-only buttons we should show visible focus even when not keyboard focused (keyboard-only vs forced visible?). I'd prefer always-visible for consistency in the console.
Aria Gomez: always-visible could be noisy in dense tables. maybe we only do always-visible at compact density or when row is focusable.
Alex Rivera: suggestion: keep default focus visible for keyboard, but add an optional token `focus-visible-mode: always|keyboard-only` for consumers. then console can opt-in where density is low.
Maria Chen: I like the token approach. adds flexibility without changing default behaviors.
DesignBot: Reminder: Please attach the a11y audit checklist when finalizing.
Dave K: table density — compact (-2) reduces row padding by 6px. UX concern: icon buttons become too small. Do we bump icon min hit area to 32px?
Samir Patel: yes, minimum 32px target. else mobile tap area suffers.
Maria Chen: agreed — enforcing min 32px for any button but allowing visual shrink. updated component spec shows `minHit: 32px`.
Alex Rivera: copy tweak: primary btn text shouldn't be ALL CAPS. feels heavy in long actions ("DEPLOY MODEL"). recommend sentence case.
Aria Gomez: +1 for sentence case. Also toasts: current draft auto-dismiss = 4s. For error toasts, keep them sticky or require explicit dismiss.
Maria Chen: plan: success/info 4s, warning 6s, error sticky with a close icon. stacking limited to 3.
Dave K: modal focus trap — I reproduced a bug where focus escapes when using nested dropdown inside modal. Filing a ticket but design note: modal needs a visible close and an escape fallback.
Maria Chen: thanks. can you add repro steps in the ticket? I'll add a modal pattern update: `modal-contains-focusable-portal: true` and note dropdown z-index + focus handling.
Samir Patel: aria suggestion for icon-only: `aria-label=\"More options\"` and if button toggles menu, add `aria-expanded` state.
Alex Rivera: small code example in spec would help: `<button class=\"btn-icon\" aria-label=\"Close\" aria-expanded=\"false\">`
Maria Chen: added that snippet to spec. also renaming spacing tokens: `space-1 -> s-xxs`, `space-2 -> s-xs` to match new naming scheme.
Aria Gomez: will the rename break existing consumers? need migration docs / alias tokens for one release cycle.
Maria Chen: yes — will ship aliases and deprecation note for two releases.
DesignBot: Action created: #DES-314 button a11y tokens + migration (assignee: Maria Chen).
Dave K: visual QA volunteers: I'll test modal + forms, Alex will test tables and compact mode, Aria will test toasts + copy.
Alex Rivera: quick mock nit — the tertiary hover feels too faint on low-contrast themes. can we increase hover alpha from 6% to 12% on dark surfaces?
Maria Chen: bump to 12% on dark, keep 6% on light. I'll push update to Figma and ping again.
Samir Patel: one last check: keyboard order in compact tables — ensure action column is last logically. saves tab cycles.
Maria Chen: noted. thanks all, will post updated spec and a patch branch later today. :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: thanks — looking forward to the PR.
DesignBot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 48h.
